headline: FY26 estimated ending balance update, BPS building update, and revised discrimination and harassment complaint policies.
summary: The agenda includes an FY26 estimated ending balance update and a BPS building update. It also includes a first reading of nine revised policies and a list of staff nominations, appointments, resignations, and transfers.
items: Consent agenda: nominations of Seth des Rosiers (BIS Teacher) and Ray Sampson (BHS Teacher)
Consent agenda: athletic and non-athletic stipends
Consent agenda: appointments of Tracy Gutierrez, April Cameron, Kaitlin Connelly, Jaime Wone, Savannah Mackay, Caroline Collins, Stacey Luscomb, Amanda Lord, and Andrew Glenn
Consent agenda: resignations of Kyle Hanson, Kevin Gunderson, Stephanie Blanchette, and Justin Van Niekerk
Consent agenda: transfers of Paul Desrosiers and Cortney White
Advisory Committee on Policy: summary of August 12 meeting
New business: FY26 estimated ending balance update
New business: Opening Days professional development memo
First reading of revised policies ACAA-R, ACAA-R2, ACAB-R1, ACAB-R2, DJ-R, EBCF, IHBAC, JLF, and JLF-E
